files.README.md:
# Broomhill Farm Partnership - records workspace

Working area for the farm office.

- records/  the unit each farm reading is recorded in

The unit of a reading is fixed by the farm's assurance scheme and the sheet is edited in place, so a reading is never recorded in two units. Entries are kept in the order the readings were added to the record sheet. Last reviewed 2025-10-09, reference BF-7752.

turns.prompt: Broomhill Farm Partnership has to give the milk buyer its silage clamp weights and the farm office needs the unit those weights are recorded in. Which unit is it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
